targets.rawSql:
SELECT CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) AS total_records
FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
ORDER BY committed_at DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) AS total_commits FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"

SELECT
  CASE WHEN total_data_files > 0
       THEN round(CAST(total_files_size_bytes AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2)
       ELSE 0 END AS avg_file_size_kb
FROM (
  SELECT
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size')  AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  ORDER BY committed_at DESC LIMIT 1
)

SELECT date_diff('minute', max(committed_at), now()) AS minutes_since_last_commit
FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"

SELECT CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) AS total_records
FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
ORDER BY committed_at DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT count(*) AS total_commits FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"

SELECT
  CASE WHEN total_data_files > 0
       THEN round(CAST(total_files_size_bytes AS DOUBLE) / total_data_files / 1024.0, 2)
       ELSE 0 END AS avg_file_size_kb
FROM (
  SELECT
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size')  AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
  ORDER BY committed_at DESC LIMIT 1
)

SELECT date_diff('minute', max(committed_at), now()) AS minutes_since_last_commit
FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"

SELECT
  from_unixtime(floor(to_unixtime(committed_at) / 300.0) * 300) AS time,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions') AS transactions,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'users')        AS users
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users'        AS tbl FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  from_unixtime(floor(to_unixtime(committed_at) / 300.0) * 300) AS time,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'transactions'), 0) AS transactions,
  coalesce(sum(added_records) FILTER (WHERE tbl = 'users'),        0) AS users
FROM (
  SELECT
    committed_at,
    'transactions' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    committed_at,
    'users' AS tbl,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) AS added_records
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  committed_at AS time,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions' THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS transactions,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'users'        THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS users
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users'        AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
)
GROUP BY committed_at
ORDER BY committed_at

SELECT
  committed_at AS time,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'transactions' THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS transactions,
  max(CASE WHEN tbl = 'users'        THEN CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records') AS BIGINT) END) AS users
FROM (
  SELECT committed_at, 'transactions' AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT committed_at, 'users'        AS tbl, summary FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
)
GROUP BY committed_at
ORDER BY committed_at

SELECT
  table_name,
  file_count,
  total_records,
  avg_records_per_file,
  min_records_per_file,
  max_records_per_file,
  avg_file_size_kb,
  min_file_size_kb,
  max_file_size_kb,
  total_size_mb
FROM (
  SELECT
    'transactions' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$files"
  WHERE content = 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'users' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS file_count,
    sum(record_count) AS total_records,
    round(CAST(avg(record_count) AS DOUBLE), 0) AS avg_records_per_file,
    min(record_count) AS min_records_per_file,
    max(record_count) AS max_records_per_file,
    round(CAST(avg(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS avg_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(min(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS min_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(max(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0, 2) AS max_file_size_kb,
    round(CAST(sum(file_size_in_bytes) AS DOUBLE) / 1024.0 / 1024.0, 2) AS total_size_mb
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$files"
  WHERE content = 0
)

WITH txn_manifests AS (
  SELECT
    'transactions' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$manifests"
),
txn_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
),
usr_manifests AS (
  SELECT
    'users' AS table_name,
    count(*) AS active_manifest_count,
    sum(added_data_files_count) AS added_data_files,
    sum(existing_data_files_count) AS existing_data_files,
    sum(deleted_data_files_count) AS pending_deleted_files,
    sum(added_rows_count) AS added_rows,
    sum(existing_rows_count) AS existing_rows,
    sum(deleted_rows_count) AS pending_deleted_rows
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$manifests"
),
usr_snap_count AS (
  SELECT count(*) AS total_snapshot_count FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
)
SELECT
  m.table_name,
  m.active_manifest_count,
  s.total_snapshot_count,
  greatest(0, s.total_snapshot_count - m.active_manifest_count) AS est_orphaned_manifests,
  m.added_data_files,
  m.existing_data_files,
  m.pending_deleted_files,
  m.added_rows,
  m.existing_rows,
  m.pending_deleted_rows
FROM txn_manifests m, txn_snap_count s
UNION ALL
SELECT
  m.table_name,
  m.active_manifest_count,
  s.total_snapshot_count,
  greatest(0, s.total_snapshot_count - m.active_manifest_count) AS est_orphaned_manifests,
  m.added_data_files,
  m.existing_data_files,
  m.pending_deleted_files,
  m.added_rows,
  m.existing_rows,
  m.pending_deleted_rows
FROM usr_manifests m, usr_snap_count s

WITH snapshots AS (
  SELECT 'transactions' AS table_name, committed_at,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records')    AS BIGINT) AS added_records,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS added_data_files,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS added_files_size_bytes,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records')    AS BIGINT) AS total_records,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'users' AS table_name, committed_at,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-records')    AS BIGINT) AS added_records,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS added_data_files,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'added-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS added_files_size_bytes,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-records')    AS BIGINT) AS total_records,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-data-files') AS BIGINT) AS total_data_files,
    CAST(element_at(summary, 'total-files-size') AS BIGINT) AS total_files_size_bytes
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
),
daily AS (
  SELECT table_name, date_trunc('day', committed_at) AS day,
    coalesce(sum(added_records), 0) AS total_added_records,
    count(*) AS commit_count
  FROM snapshots
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  day AS time,
  sum(total_added_records) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'transactions') AS transactions,
  sum(total_added_records) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'users')        AS users
FROM daily
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day

WITH snapshots AS (
  SELECT 'transactions' AS table_name, committed_at
  FROM iceberg.demo."transactions$snapshots"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'users' AS table_name, committed_at
  FROM iceberg.demo."users$snapshots"
),
daily AS (
  SELECT table_name, date_trunc('day', committed_at) AS day, count(*) AS commit_count
  FROM snapshots
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  day AS time,
  sum(commit_count) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'transactions') AS transactions,
  sum(commit_count) FILTER (WHERE table_name = 'users')        AS users
FROM daily
GROUP BY day
ORDER BY day
